description: Fixed group-specific wage profiles with centered and uncentered interaction terms.
source: Original synthetic OpenEconometrics teaching data; not real observations.

columns.name: sector
columns.description: Fictional group indicator: 0 = group A, 1 = group B.

columns.name: experience_centered
columns.description: Work experience minus the 15-year reference value.

columns.name: sector_experience
columns.description: sector multiplied by experience_centered; includes the same centering as the main term.
columns.unit: Indicator multiplied by years relative to 15

columns.name: sector_experience_raw
columns.description: sector multiplied by uncentered experience, for the equivalent uncentered specification.
